name: Wishing Star
source:
You are stargazing one night, making a wish on a shooting star. Little do you know, that the shooting star heard your wish. What exactly was your wish, again...?

[From [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/wishing-star]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天晚上，你正在观星，对着一颗流星许愿。你却不知道，流星听到了你的愿望。你的愿望到底是什么……？

[来自[url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/wishing-star]itch.io[/url]]
